nativeBaseline.reference: search landmark containing a native search input and native button clear control

library: provide search-landmark semantics while preserving native input and button behavior
clear the query and restore focus to the input when an accepted clear action runs
consumer: author localized accessible names for the search input and icon-only clear control
own submit/immediate query policy, routing, results, filtering, sorting, persistence, and data services

notes: SearchField does not define an APG combobox/autocomplete interaction; suggestions and selection remain separate patterns.

Authored naming, native semantics, IME handling at the consuming workflow, and clear-focus restoration are covered by structural/browser evidence rather than a component-specific spoken-announcement claim.
